name: First Answer
description: Access your First Answer data directly from Claude: brand visibility, the AI responses behind the numbers, and the sources models cite. Track prompts across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Mode, compare against competitors, and see which domains and pages drive your mentions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add First Answer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add First Answer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.firstanswer.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the First Answer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: First Answer lists 18 MCP tools, including get_brand, get_cited_source_related_prompts, get_cited_source_url_related_prompts, get_cited_source_urls, get_dashboard, get_monitored_competitor, get_monitored_prompt, get_monitored_prompt_citations, get_monitored_prompt_responses, get_monitored_prompt_search_queries, get_recommendation, and list_brands.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to First Answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to First Answer in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does First Answer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: First Answer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
First Answer is developed by First Answer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
